description: This file contains implementation of functions for managing a data buffer structure, including checking if full, clearing, copying, adding elements, and a modular arithmetic function. It also includes commented-out debugging and table printing functions.

methods.name: dbIsFull
methods.description: Checks if the data buffer is full based on its size and maximum capacity.

methods.name: dbClear
methods.description: Clears the data buffer by resetting its size to zero.

methods.name: dbCopy
methods.description: Copies elements from a source data buffer to a target data buffer.

methods.name: dbAdd
methods.description: Adds a new element to the data buffer if it's not full.

methods.name: modp
methods.description: Calculates a modular value based on EF_PERIOD for a given parameter.
